title: Onboard elysia-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Onboard Elysia-13b v1.0 with validated performance profiles for A100/H100, tokenization metadata, recommended runtime configs, and automation for publishing changelog entries. No breaking changes to existing model APIs.
description: This PR onboards Elysia-13b v1.0 into the model registry. It adds canonical metadata (architecture, tokenizer, max_sequence_length, supported quantizations), performance profiles collected on representative hardware (A100-40GB, H100-80GB, quantized CPU-friendly baselines), and ties the onboarding to the changelog/release-notes automation so entries are generated and published automatically when the model is released. Motivation: Elysia-13b is a high-quality open model used by several customers; making it first-class in the registry enables consistent serving configurations, cost estimates, and automated release notes for downstream teams. Includes small docs page and unit tests for the perf profile validator. Rollout plan: merge to main, CI must pass, then the release pipeline will tag and publish profiles to the perf service. If users need custom profiles they can override via the registry API.
commit_summary: - Add metadata YAML for elysia-13b v1.0; - Add perf profiles JSON for a100/h100/quantized baselines; - Add docs page and quickstart snippet; - Add test coverage for profile validator; - Hook model metadata to changelog-gen pipeline and add templating for release notes
changed_areas_summary: Model metadata, perf profiles, changelog automation integration, docs and tests. Small CI addition to validate profile schema and example quickstart added.
